header_sentences: See Bear, and Hereditary; also see Connate, and Generation.

contexts.text: The nativities of the heavens and earths () = the formations of the celestial man.
Under Book, see this reference.
The born, or children () = the regenerate who have intelligence of what is good and true.
The nativities of Noah () = a description of the reformation or regeneration of the new Church.
Man when born is the lowest of all living things. CL 350. TCR 417.
Man is born into no exercise of his life...

These are the nativities of the sons of Noah () = the derivations of the doctrinals and worships of the Ancient Church... In the outward sense, nativities are the generations of one from another; but in the inward sense, regard celestial and spiritual things, or those which are of charity and faith, thus here, the nativities which are of the Church...
According to their births () = as they could be reformed. Birth = reformation; for when a man is reborn or regenerated by the Lord, each and all things which he receives anew are births...

These are the nativities of Shem () = the derivations of the second Ancient Church. Nativities = the origin and derivation of doctrinals and worships... Wherefore when any Church is born, it is said that there were nativities of it. Illustrated.
These are the nativities of Terah () = the origins and derivations of idolatries...
The land of his nativity () = origin.
From thy nativity () = corporeal and worldly exterior things.
Through birth from the virgin mother He derived infirmities like those of man in general.
Being born from Jehovah...
He was born as another man... AC 1450. AC 1460. AC 1542:2. AC 1616. AC 1893:2. AC 1894:end. AC 1902. AC 4692:5. AC 4963:3.
Where there is hereditary evil there is also falsity, the latter is born from the former, but falsity from evil cannot be born until the man is imbued with scientifics and Knowledges...
No man can ever be born from any man without deriving evil thence...
If He had been born Divine, that is, without evil...
The Lord could have assumed the Human without birth...

If man were imbued with no hereditary evil, he would be born rational immediately from the marriage of the celestial things of the inward man with its spiritual things, and the Scientific would be born through the Rational, so that man would possess the whole Rational and the whole Scientific at his coming into the world... as may be inferred from the fact that all animals are born into the whole Scientific... What causes man to be born (into no knowledge) is hereditary evil from the father and mother, for thus all his faculties are turned the wrong way about.
Man when born has not one whit of good of himself, but is completely defiled with hereditary evil. AC 4644:2.
Generations and nativities = those things which are of faith.
Those born in the house () = the celestial. (See AC 1708.) AE 601:12.
They know not but that they were born in Heaven.
Immediately after the birth of infants Angels from the Heaven of innocence are with them.
Born of God () = those who are in love and thence in faith.
Man not born into any knowledge, nor into anything rational, but only into the capacity of receiving them. AC 3161:2. AC 3175:2. AC 5081. TCR 480:end.
If spiritual truth flowed in from within, as good does, man would be born into the whole Rational and at the same time into the whole Scientific, so that he would not need to learn anything.
He was born a Man, but was conceived from God.
That were born to him () = to come forth from the Divine.
The Lord's Divine Human was not only conceived, but was also born from Jehovah... AC 2649:2. AC 2798.
If the Most Ancient Church had continued in its integrity, the Lord would have had no need to be born a Man.
(Man is born into both worlds.)
He was born from the virgin Mary as another man, but when again born, or made Divine, it was from Jehovah...
The Divine Human which was born from eternity was also born in time, and being born in time, and being glorified, is the same thing. Signified.
Birth () = the Spiritual of love, here, Divine celestial and spiritual things...
The land of my birth () = the maternal hereditary as to falsity.
As soon as man is born, he is introduced into a state of innocence...
He who is born anew is like an infant...
These are the nativities of Ishmael () = the derivations of that spiritual Church... AC 3267. AC 3279.
Good and truth are like offspring, being conceived, carried in the womb, born, etc. AC 3308.
Whatever is born derives being from the father and manifesting from the mother; there must be both.
Natural good is the good into which a man is born... this he derives from his parents...
(Parallel between man's two births.)
The dew of thy birth () = the celestial of love.
There is no marriage of good and truth in the Natural with man when he is born, for man alone is not born in Divine order...
Children () = truths. AC 4270. AC 4377. AC 4383. AE 411:26.
Man when first born is merely corporeal, but there is a capacity in him of being perfected...
To thy birth () = to truth thence. Birth = the truth which is from good; for all truth is born from good... AC 4094. AC 10335:3.
The good of the Natural does not mean the good into which a man is born, or which he derives from his parents, but good which as to its origin is spiritual; into this no one is born...
Thus man is continually being born...

All men are born natural with the power to become either celestial or spiritual; the Lord alone was born spiritual celestial, and therefore was born at Bethlehem... The reason He was born spiritual celestial was that the Divine was in Him. AC 4594.
Born to him () = their origin.
These are the nativities of Esau () = derivations in the Lord's Divine good natural... The Lord's Divine good natural, which is represented by Esau, is the Divine he had from birth... AC 4644.
Nativities () = the derivations of those things of the Church, namely, of truth from good, or of faith from love.
The child is not () = that there was no faith in Him. Child = truth of faith.
Pharaoh's birth day () = when the Natural is being regenerated. To be born = to be regenerated. Explained.
To be born = to be reborn.
As to our birth () = concerning the truths of faith there. Birth = that of truth from good. Explained.
Born of God = those who are regenerated by the Lord, and are thence in good. AC 9454. AC 10829:end. DLord 18:end. AE 329:end.
Animals... are born into all things which belong to them...
People remain in the dogmas in which they were born... AC 8993:2. AC 9300:5. DSS 92.
Birth = the new birth through faith and charity.
Both the Intellectual and the Voluntary are born from the Internal... for every affection of good and truth... is born from no other source...
Under Animal, see this reference.

If man were in order... above all animals he would be born not only into scientifics, but also into all spiritual truths and celestial goods, and thus into all wisdom and intelligence... AC 7750:2. HH 352:3.
Man is born into those things which are of the voluntary part; hence the people of the Most Ancient Church were born into the good of love in so far as they had good in their Voluntary.
Hence His Human was not Divine from birth.
The generations or nativities of truths from good are as the generations or nativities of sons and daughters from a parent...

Every man is born into the evils of the love of self and of the world from his parents... AC 9278:2. HH 296. HH 424. NJHD 79:end. DLife 68. DLife 110. DP 83. AR 692:2. CL 525. TCR 520. General article. TCR 612. TCR 658:5. DP 281:2. CL 94.
(Necessity of man's being born anew.)
Children () = derived truths and goods.
They who have been born within the Church... are not to contract marriages with those born out of the Church...
Children or sons = truths of faith. References. AC 9372:5.
Man when born as to hereditary evils is a Hell in the least form.
Why the Lord willed to be born in our Earth. General article. EU 113. SE 4376.
The new understanding and will into which man is born from the Lord... AC 10660, Signified.
Man is born natural...
Children () = those who are of the Church.
Man is born in mere ignorance... for he is born hereditarily into all evil of the love of self and the world. HH 202.
Man is born into evils of every kind, and thence into falsities of every kind...
Little children (in Heaven) do not know that they were born in the world, wherefore they believe that they were born in Heaven; thus they do not know of any birth but the spiritual one...
The means of reformation are... that man is born into mere ignorance...
Man is born into the ultimate degree of the natural world...
These three degrees of height are in every man from his birth...
Every man is born into the capacity of understanding truths even to the inmost degree...
From birth the spiritual mind is not open, but only in the potency of being opened... For man is born animal, but becomes man. CL 156. [152a] 2.
Man comes into the first degree which is natural when he is born...

If man were born into the love in which he was created, he would not be in any evil, nay, he would not know what evil is... If man were born into this love he would not be born into the thick darkness of ignorance, as now every man is, but into a certain light of knowledge and thence of intelligence, and into these he would also quickly come...

When the love of the neighbour was turned into self-love, man could no longer be born into the light of knowledge and intelligence, but into the thick darkness of ignorance, because into the ultimate plane of life...
An infant is born black from a black...
Every infant is born into this external of life.
From this primitive formation it arises that the male is born intellectual, and the female voluntary...
Why man is not born into the knowledge of any love, when yet beasts and birds... are born into the knowledges of all their loves. Fully Explained. TCR 48:8.
Man is born into no knowledge, that he may be able to come into all... and he is born into no love, that he may come into all...
Every man is born corporeal, becomes sensual, then natural, and successively rational...
Emperors, kings, etc. who are born to command, if they humble themselves before God, are sometimes less in the love of dominion than men sprung from the lowest orders.
Man (is born) into the inclination to love himself and the world, and also the neighbour and God...
Unless broken through new birth from the Lord.
(Correspondence of regeneration to conception, gestation, birth, and education.) General article... Hence natural births in the Word mean spiritual births. Illustrated. AE 434:7.
As man is born spiritual as to the interiors of his mind, differently from a beast...
Those who are born in the Church and are attached to it merely on that account. Signified.
To be born = to be regenerated.
